cards.answer: Draven is a marksman who sustains empowered physical attacks by catching his axes. Axe catches also reset his movement and attack speed ability, helping him keep attacking.
cards.counterplay: Pressure axe landing spots and avoid prolonged exchanges while he keeps catching axes.

citations.quote: Name: Draven. Official role tags: Marksman.
Draven's next attack will deal bonus physical damage.
If Draven catches it, he automatically readies another Spinning Axe.

facts.claim: sustains empowered physical attacks by catching his axes

citations.quote: Draven gains increased Move Speed and Attack Speed.
Catching a Spinning Axe resets Blood Rush's cooldown.

facts.claim: Axe catches also reset his movement and attack speed ability, helping him keep attacking.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing his axe-catching attack pattern is central to fighting him.

cards.answer: League of Draven builds Adoration when Draven catches axes or kills minions, monsters, or turrets. Champion kills consume his Adoration for bonus gold; dying loses some Adoration.
cards.counterplay: Play cautiously when he threatens a champion kill and pressure him when he moves to catch axes.

citations.quote: Innate: Draven gains an Adoration stack when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or turret.

facts.claim: League of Draven builds Adoration when Draven catches axes or kills minions, monsters, or turrets.

citations.quote: When Draven kills an enemy champion, he consumes all Adoration stacks to gain bonus gold.

facts.claim: Champion kills consume his Adoration for bonus gold

citations.quote: He loses Adoration stacks when he dies.

cards.priority_reason: Champion kills convert accumulated stacks into an economic advantage.
uncertainties: The supplied evidence does not establish a distinctive passive visual cue.

cards.answer: Spinning Axe empowers his next basic attack with bonus physical damage; catching the bouncing axe readies another empowered attack. He can hold two Spinning Axes at once. Ground markers visible to both teams show where axes will land, with landing locations determined by his movement.
cards.counterplay: Use axe landing markers to aim pressure where he wants to move.

citations.quote: Active: Draven's next basic attack will throw an axe, dealing bonus physical damage.
If Draven catches the axe, he gains Spinning Axe's empowered attack again.

facts.claim: Spinning Axe empowers his next basic attack with bonus physical damage; catching the bouncing axe readies another empowered attack.

citations.quote: Draven can hold up to two Spinning Axes at once.

facts.claim: He can hold two Spinning Axes at once.

citations.quote: Spinning Axe will place a visual cue on the ground where it will land. This visual cue is visible to both teams, although Draven himself will see a more prominent marker.
The landing location is determined by Draven's movement speed and direction at the time Spinning Axe hits the target.

facts.claim: Ground markers visible to both teams show where axes will land, with landing locations determined by his movement.

cards.priority_reason: His main damage pattern also signals where he may move next.

cards.answer: Blood Rush briefly grants attack speed and a rapidly fading movement speed boost. Catching a Spinning Axe resets its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Avoid chasing through axe catches, and pressure him when he misses a catch.

citations.quote: Active: Draven briefly gains bonus attack speed and a burst of movement speed, also becoming ghosted.
The Move Speed bonus decreases rapidly over its duration.

facts.claim: Blood Rush briefly grants attack speed and a rapidly fading movement speed boost.

citations.quote: Catching a Spinning Axe resets Blood Rush's cooldown.

facts.claim: Catching a Spinning Axe resets its cooldown.

cards.priority_reason: Axe catches repeatedly restore access to his combat speed boost.

cards.answer: Stand Aside throws axes in a line, dealing physical damage, knocking enemies aside, and slowing them.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the axes and look for an opening after he uses them.

citations.quote: Active: Draven throws a fan of axes in a line in the target direction that deal physical damage to enemies hit, knocking them aside and slowing them.

facts.claim: Stand Aside throws axes in a line, dealing physical damage, knocking enemies aside, and slowing them.

cards.priority_reason: The displacement and slow matter when approaching or escaping him.

cards.answer: Whirling Death sends axes across the map, dealing physical damage outward and again on their return; hitting a champion triggers their return, and Draven can recall them early. Damage decreases as enemies are hit and resets when the axes reverse. Champions damaged to or below a health threshold equal to his Adoration stacks are executed.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the outgoing axes and move clear of their return path, especially when low on health.

citations.quote:
TARGET RANGE:
Global

Recast: Whirling Death slowly reverses direction and homes back to Draven, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.
Whirling Death can be recast while the axes are active, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy champion or the edge of the map.

facts.claim: Whirling Death sends axes across the map, dealing physical damage outward and again on their return; hitting a champion triggers their return, and Draven can recall them early.

citations.quote: Deals less damage for each unit hit and resets when the axes reverse direction.

facts.claim: Damage decreases as enemies are hit and resets when the axes reverse.

citations.quote: Enemy champions that are damaged to or while below a health threshold equal to the number of Adoration stacks are executed.

facts.claim: Champions damaged to or below a health threshold equal to his Adoration stacks are executed.
